description: Enumerates ALL distinct local alignments whose score equals the Smith–Waterman optimum (the set Biopython PairwiseAligner(mode='local').align(a, b) iterates; equal on 1 345 oracle pairs), capped at maxAlignments because the number of co-optimal alignments grows exponentially with repeats (tandem repeats, long gap-placement ties). Every alignment ends with an aligned pair, begins right after a zero-score cell, and is not a zero-score extension of a shorter optimal alignment (Biopython rule). Order is deterministic: end cell in row-major order, then diagonal > up > left (affine: M > X > Y) at each branch, so the first alignment equals local_align / local_align_affine. affine = false: linear gaps (gapExtend per position, gapOpen ignored); affine = true: gapOpen + k*gapExtend. With matrix = BLOSUM62 | PAM250 | EDNAFULL residues are scored by that table and gaps may be fractional (exactScore is the real score). Returns alignments (same fields as local_align); empty list when no pair scores > 0. O(len1*len2) memory: inputs above 25,000,000 cells ((len1+1)*(len2+1)) are rejected with a clear error.

maxAlignments.description: Cap on the number of alignments returned (>= 1).

affine.description: false = linear gap model (gapExtend per gap position); true = affine (gapOpen + k*gapExtend).

match.description: Score for matching base (ignored with matrix).

mismatch.description: Score for mismatching base (ignored with matrix).

gapOpen.description: Gap-open score (affine = true only; ignored by the linear model). May be fractional when matrix is given.

gapExtend.description: Gap score charged per gap position (<= 0). May be fractional when matrix is given.

matrix.description: Optional substitution matrix: any built-in matrix by EMBOSS, NCBI or Biopython name - BLOSUM62, PAM250, EBLOSUM30 ... EBLOSUM90, EPAM10 ... EPAM500, BLASTP (BLOSUM62 with the residues U = selenocysteine, O = pyrrolysine and J = leucine / isoleucine, as blastp scores them), GONNET1992, JONES, DAYHOFF, MDM78, BENNER6 / 22 / 74, JOHNSON, RISLER, GENETIC, FENG, LEVIN, MCLACHLAN, RAO, STR (protein; the fractional ones are scored exactly) or EDNAFULL, EDNAMAT, EDNASIMPLE, ENUC.4.4, BLASTN, MEGABLAST, HOXD70, TRANS (IUPAC DNA); or THE TEXT of a matrix instead of a name: several lines in the NCBI / EMBOSS / Biopython data-file format (a header line of symbols, then one row per symbol: the symbol and its scores; # lines are comments; scores may be decimals). When given, match/mismatch are ignored, residues are scored by the published table (any protein or IUPAC symbol of the matrix; case-insensitive) and gapOpen/gapExtend may be fractional (the EMBOSS needle/water models: gapOpen = -(G - E), gapExtend = -E for -gapopen G -gapextend E). The result then also carries the real-valued exactScore.

alignments.description: Local alignments, best first (same fields as local_align).

exactScore.description: Real-valued score (equals `score` for integer scoring; with matrix / fractional gaps `score` is this value rounded half away from zero).
